name: Common factors
description: Used when no specific modality pack applies (e.g. integrative, psychodynamic, systemic). Focuses on the shared ingredients of good therapy.

scale.meaning: 1 = not present in this session, 3 = partly present, 5 = strongly and skilfully present

dimensions.label: Collaboration and alliance
dimensions.description: Working with the client as a partner: checking in, agreeing focus, inviting their view.

anchors.1: The therapist mostly leads alone; the client's view is rarely sought.
anchors.3: Some checking in, but focus is mostly set by the therapist.
anchors.5: Focus and pace are agreed together; the client's view is actively invited and used.

dimensions.label: Empathic understanding
dimensions.description: Conveying an accurate understanding of the client's experience, including feelings that are not yet said.

anchors.1: Responses miss or move past what the client is feeling.
anchors.3: Accurate reflections of what was said; little of the deeper meaning.
anchors.5: Reflections capture meaning and feeling beyond the words, and the client visibly feels understood.

dimensions.label: Open exploration
dimensions.description: Using open questions and curiosity to help the client explore, rather than closed or leading questions.

anchors.3: A mix of open and closed questions.
anchors.5: Open, curious questions that deepen the client's own exploration.

dimensions.label: Space and pacing
dimensions.description: Giving the client room to speak and think; tolerating silence; not rushing.

anchors.1: The therapist talks much more than the client, or rushes past important moments.
anchors.3: Reasonable balance, with some rushed moments.
anchors.5: The client has room to think; silences and important moments are given time.

dimensions.label: Clarity of focus
dimensions.description: Keeping the session connected to what matters most to the client and to agreed goals.

anchors.1: The session drifts without connection to the client's priorities.
anchors.3: Some connection to goals, some drift.
anchors.5: The session stays meaningfully connected to what matters to the client.

dimensions.label: Summaries and closing
dimensions.description: Summarising, checking understanding and agreeing next steps.

anchors.1: No summary or check at the end.
anchors.3: A brief summary or next step.
anchors.5: Clear summaries during and at the end, with next steps agreed together.
